title: Unlawful search or seizure
description: Search or seizure without reasonable grounds

content.offence: The Director General or any other officer, exercising powers under section 22, who knows that there are no reasonable grounds for so doing, and yet searches, or causes to be searched any premises; or seizes any record, register or other document or article
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees or with both
